description.from:
## Behavior
As an author, I can assemble or dissolve text and images using particles.

## Acceptance scenarios
Given seed, text/image, density, and dimensions, when any frame is requested, then the particle state is reproducible without incremental wall-clock simulation. Expose reveal/dissolve direction, color tokens, duration, and cue-relative placement; retain source/asset provenance.

## Ownership
stdlib, toolchain, player

## Evidence
Link implementation, runnable fixtures, and verification results before closing. Keep product-boundary decisions in the parent initiative.
